dialogues.en: "Not really, because graduation's just around the corner."
dialogues.text: "Not really, because graduation's just around the corner."

dialogues.jp: 「何だ、こりゃ……？」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. No... No parties..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. No... No parties..."

dialogues.jp:
購買で買ってきたパンにかぶりつこうとした、
まさにその瞬間、胸に奇妙な痛みを覚えた。
dialogues.en:
Maybe I could throw a crazy party like last Christmas. But I
wouldn't want to give myself a bad name by screwing up a
graduation party.
dialogues.text:
Maybe I could throw a crazy party like last Christmas. But I
wouldn't want to give myself a bad name by screwing up a
graduation party.

dialogues.jp:
長い長い針で、奥の方をちくりとやられたよう
な感覚……。
dialogues.en: Miharu gave me a big smile.
dialogues.text: Miharu gave me a big smile.

dialogues.jp: 「いつ……いたた……」
dialogues.en: "Miharu used to come to shop at this store a lot."
dialogues.text: "Miharu used to come to shop at this store a lot."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうした朝倉。楽しそうな顔をして。俺も混
　ぜろ」
dialogues.en: "Why don't we walk?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't we walk?"

dialogues.jp:
顔をしかめつつ、目の前に立ったスカポンタン
を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Miharu and I walked along the street lined with stores.
dialogues.text: Miharu and I walked along the street lined with stores.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　何だ？　パンに針か剃刀でも混ざって
　いたか？」
dialogues.en: "Can I stop by this bookstore?"
dialogues.text: "Can I stop by this bookstore?"

dialogues.jp: 口元までやっていたカレーパンを下ろす。
dialogues.en: Miharu ran into a bookstore nearby.
dialogues.text: Miharu ran into a bookstore nearby.

dialogues.jp:
胸の針は既に抜き取られていたが、それは食欲
を道連れにしていた。
dialogues.en:
"The real Miharu used to come to this bookstore as well.
Obviously, you two have the same taste."
dialogues.text:
"The real Miharu used to come to this bookstore as well.
Obviously, you two have the same taste."

dialogues.en:
Inside the bookstore, Miharu picked up a lunch recipe book
and flipped through its pages.
dialogues.text:
Inside the bookstore, Miharu picked up a lunch recipe book
and flipped through its pages.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おまえは鬼畜か。俺に針入りパンを渡すな」
dialogues.en: "I've haven't made lunch yet, but I find it intriguing."
dialogues.text: "I've haven't made lunch yet, but I find it intriguing."

dialogues.jp: がたんと席を立ち、机に置いたパンに目をやる。
dialogues.en: "Let me see..."
dialogues.text: "Let me see..."

dialogues.jp:
「食わないなら捨てるだけだから、まあ、食え
　よ」
dialogues.en: I looked over at the book.
dialogues.text: I looked over at the book.

dialogues.jp:
ひらひらと手を振り、昼休みにざわつく教室を
後にした。
dialogues.en: "Wow, they all look delicious."
dialogues.text: "Wow, they all look delicious."

dialogues.jp:
ギイイ──と重たい鉄の扉を開け、青空の下に
出る。ふわっと流れてきた空気を押しのけて。
dialogues.en:
I remember Miharu used to make things like that for her
lunch.
dialogues.text:
I remember Miharu used to make things like that for her
lunch.

dialogues.jp:
胸の痛みはすでに消えていたけれど、吹き渡る
風はやっぱり気持ちよかった。
dialogues.en: "Would you like a lunch like this?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like a lunch like this?"

dialogues.en: "I would love it..."
dialogues.text: "I would love it..."

dialogues.jp:
屋上に張り巡らされた金網の前に、見慣れたリ
ボンが揺れていた。
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'll buy this book then."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'll buy this book then."

dialogues.jp: 「音夢」
dialogues.en: Miharu took the book to the cashier.
dialogues.text: Miharu took the book to the cashier.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Heehee. I'll make you lunch tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Heehee. I'll make you lunch tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
振り返った音夢が、なんとなくバツの悪そうな
笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
"What? Are you sure? But you've never made one before,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"What? Are you sure? But you've never made one before,
right?"

dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだ？　こんなところで、ボケッと
　しくさって」
dialogues.en: "Are you really sure?"
dialogues.text: "Are you really sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ボケ……て、あのね。屋上に独り｛たたず／佇｝む乙女に
　向かって、それはないんじゃない？」
dialogues.en: "You don't trust me?"
dialogues.text: "You don't trust me?"

dialogues.jp: と、当たりを見回す。
dialogues.en: Miharu looked into my face with a grin.
dialogues.text: Miharu looked into my face with a grin.

dialogues.jp: 「ひとりでもないだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. I'll make you a delicious lunch."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. I'll make you a delicious lunch."

dialogues.jp: 昼休みとあって、学生の姿がちらほら見える。
dialogues.en: I was still a bit worried...
dialogues.text: I was still a bit worried...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、どうしたの？　兄さんが、屋上に来る
　なんて」
dialogues.en: "So take me to some nice stores, please."
dialogues.text: "So take me to some nice stores, please."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんがって、俺だって屋上くらい来るぞ？」
dialogues.en: So we went to a grocery store and bought some food.
dialogues.text: So we went to a grocery store and bought some food.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、階段……」
dialogues.en: "That was a lot of fun! I got lots of stuff."
dialogues.text: "That was a lot of fun! I got lots of stuff."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: With a big smile, Miharu lifted up the big plastic bags.
dialogues.text: With a big smile, Miharu lifted up the big plastic bags.

dialogues.jp:
やれやれと首を振りつつ、音夢の横に並ぶ。眼
下には、中庭が広がっていた。
dialogues.en: "To me, all the vegetables look the same."
dialogues.text: "To me, all the vegetables look the same."

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっとな。外の空気が吸いたくなっただけ
　だ。んで、お前は？」
dialogues.en: Of course, I was carrying some bags too.
dialogues.text: Of course, I was carrying some bags too.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "I know. But in fact, they're very different."
dialogues.text: "I know. But in fact, they're very different."

dialogues.jp:
どうしたんだろうか？　何だか元気がないよう
に見えるが……。
dialogues.en: "You can tell, huh?"
dialogues.text: "You can tell, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en:
"Yes, I can tell what tastes good and bad. As for fish, I
can tell by looking in their eyes."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, I can tell what tastes good and bad. As for fish, I
can tell by looking in their eyes."

dialogues.jp:
喉の奥で鳴っているような返事をしながら、音
夢が金網の下にぼんやり視線を向けた。

そこには、屋上と同じように何人もの学生の姿
がある。ベンチに座っていたり、歩いていたり、
あるいは遊んでいたり……。
dialogues.en: Miharu smiled proudly.
dialogues.text: Miharu smiled proudly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、兄さん、見える？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want this?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want this?"

dialogues.jp:
ちくり──また、胸が痛んだ。深いところへ、
容赦なく侵入してくる痛みだ。
dialogues.en: Miharu offered me a banana from one of her bags.
dialogues.text: Miharu offered me a banana from one of her bags.

dialogues.jp:
音夢はどうしてか、唇を噛んで、外を一心に見
つめている。
dialogues.en: I didn't see her buy any bananas.
dialogues.text: I didn't see her buy any bananas.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「私……目がいいから……」
dialogues.en: "Fresh picked ones are always the best."
dialogues.text: "Fresh picked ones are always the best."

dialogues.jp:
どこぞの命知らずが、音夢の恥ずかしいポエム
を入手し、瓦版のように配布しているのだろう
か？
dialogues.en: Fresh picked? You just took one out of a bunch of them.
dialogues.text: Fresh picked? You just took one out of a bunch of them.

dialogues.jp:
などと思って目を懲らすが、中庭の様子には、
やはりおかしな点などない。
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.jp: 「おい、音夢──」
dialogues.en: I peeled my banana.
dialogues.text: I peeled my banana.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろもどかしくなって、音夢に顔を向けよ
うとして──俺も気がついた。
dialogues.en: Munch... munch...
dialogues.text: Munch... munch...

dialogues.jp: 「……美春か？　お前、美春を見ているのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you like it? I picked them because they looked sweaty."
dialogues.text: "Do you like it? I picked them because they looked sweaty."

dialogues.jp:
だとしたら、まあ、確かに目はいい。俺なんか、
ぎゅっと目を細めて、よくよく分かったくらい
なのだから。
dialogues.en: "It's perfect -- not too soft, not too hard."
dialogues.text: "It's perfect -- not too soft, not too hard."

dialogues.jp:
豆粒くらいに縮んだ美春は、ベンチに腰かけて、
何人かの学生と一緒に、弁当を食べていた。
dialogues.en:
I remember when I came out shopping with the real Miharu,
she surely must have given me a banana as well.
dialogues.text:
I remember when I came out shopping with the real Miharu,
she surely must have given me a banana as well.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「私……バカだから……」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, that was the first time I've ever been to a store
like that, but I didn't feel that way at all, especially
when I was actually shopping."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, that was the first time I've ever been to a store
like that, but I didn't feel that way at all, especially
when I was actually shopping."

dialogues.jp:
音夢はおかしなくらいうつろな表情で、胸元の
リボンをぎゅっと掴んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Certainly, when Miharu was shopping she'd seemed like she'd
been doing it for years.
dialogues.text:
Certainly, when Miharu was shopping she'd seemed like she'd
been doing it for years.

dialogues.jp: 視線はじっと、中庭へと注いだまま……。
dialogues.en: "I guess you've still got some memories left. "
dialogues.text: "I guess you've still got some memories left. "

dialogues.jp:
蛇口があれば、眼下の連中がみんな海へと流さ
れて行くんじゃないか、そんな変な考えがふと
｛のうり／脳裡｝に浮かぶ。
dialogues.en:
"I'm not sure about that yet, because I didn't feel a strong
sensation."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not sure about that yet, because I didn't feel a strong
sensation."

dialogues.jp: いてて……また、胸が……。
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あそこに居るのは、美春じゃないのに……」
dialogues.en:
"But if I keep doing this, I think something is going to
come back to my mind."
dialogues.text:
"But if I keep doing this, I think something is going to
come back to my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「おべんと食べながら笑っているのは、本当の
　美春じゃないのに……」
dialogues.en:
After eating the banana, I reached out to help Miharu with
her bags.
dialogues.text:
After eating the banana, I reached out to help Miharu with
her bags.

dialogues.jp:
二の腕に手を置く。力を入れたつもりもないの
に、音夢は｛ひど／酷｝く驚いた顔をした。
dialogues.en: I've done the exactly the same thing in the past as well.
dialogues.text: I've done the exactly the same thing in the past as well.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ご、ごめんなさい、私……」
dialogues.en:
"I'll try my best for people who love me as Miharu-san.
That's why..."
dialogues.text:
"I'll try my best for people who love me as Miharu-san.
That's why..."

dialogues.jp: するりと、手から身体が逃げていった。
dialogues.en: Miharu walked a few steps forward.
dialogues.text: Miharu walked a few steps forward.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢ッ！」
dialogues.en: "That's why -- I hope you'll like my lunch tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "That's why -- I hope you'll like my lunch tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
打ちっ放しのコンクリートに響く足音。音夢の
姿は、すぐに扉の向こうに消えてしまった。
dialogues.en: And Miharu gave me a wide happy smile.
dialogues.text: And Miharu gave me a wide happy smile.

dialogues.en: "Yeah...I'll look forward to it."
dialogues.text: "Yeah...I'll look forward to it."

dialogues.jp:
残された悲痛な声も、すぐに風に吹き散らされ
ていく。
dialogues.en:
While watching Miharu, I felt like blushing. l looked away
from her eyes a little.
dialogues.text:
While watching Miharu, I felt like blushing. l looked away
from her eyes a little.

dialogues.jp:
大声を出したことで、屋上にいた学生全員の視
線を集めていた。
dialogues.en: Then I took her home by bus as usual.
dialogues.text: Then I took her home by bus as usual.

dialogues.jp: 「……くそっ」
dialogues.en:
I wonder what kind of lunch Miharu will make for me
tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
I wonder what kind of lunch Miharu will make for me
tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: 肩をすくめ、のそのそと出入り口に向かう。
dialogues.en: I can't wait.
dialogues.text: I can't wait.

dialogues.jp: 胸の痛みは、さっきよりも増していた……。
dialogues.en: I giggled.
dialogues.text: I giggled.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢と屋上にて◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miharu◆

dialogues.jp:
胸に奇妙な痛みを覚えて、屋上に行くと音夢が
ひとり｛たたず／佇｝んでいた。
dialogues.en: "Let me take you around town, then."
dialogues.text: "Let me take you around town, then."

dialogues.jp:
音夢は友達と楽しそうに昼食をとる美春の姿を
見て、心を痛めていた。
dialogues.en:
I'll take her to the places I know. The places the real
Miharu and I have lots of fond memories of.
dialogues.text:
I'll take her to the places I know. The places the real
Miharu and I have lots of fond memories of.

dialogues.jp:
あの美春は本物の美春じゃないのに。本物の美
春は病院のベッドの上でひとりで眠り続けてい
るのに……と。
dialogues.en:
"I don't have much time today, but I can take you tomorrow,
since I have no classes after tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"I don't have much time today, but I can take you tomorrow,
since I have no classes after tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
悲痛な声を残して校舎内に消えた音夢。胸の痛
みは、さっきよりも増していた……。
dialogues.en: "The seniors don't have classes any more?"
dialogues.text: "The seniors don't have classes any more?"
